_how_to: Station 419 on the front page. 'tv' is a list of videos shown as a carousel on the sidebar TV (add as many as you like; each needs a url and a title, which is its headline). Video links: YouTube, Vimeo, Facebook, or a pasted <iframe> embed code. 'radio' is ONE podcast in the thin player bar under the top stories: a Spotify, Apple Podcasts, SoundCloud, Buzzsprout, Podbean or Anchor link, a pasted <iframe> embed code, an .mp3 file, or a podcast RSS feed (plays the newest episode). Empty url = 'coming soon'. Optional: 'link' (where 'at the source' goes) and, for the radio, 'image' (cover art).
